people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: You will know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.
translations.bsb: Then you will know that I have sent you this commandment so that My covenant with Levi may continue,” says the LORD of Hosts.
translations.kjv: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.
translations.asv: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant may be with Levi, saith Jehovah of hosts.
